metadata.title: शॉम्पेन जनजाति का पहला वोट-त्रिपुरा का तूफ़ान | बड़ी आदिवासी ख़बरें | Tribal News Week
metadata.description: This week's tribal India news roundup traverses Andaman & Nicobar, Tripura, and Chhattisgarh. A milestone event occurred as members of the primitive tribe on Great Nicobar Island voted for the first time, signifying a stride towards inclusion. Meanwhile, Tripura reels from a cyclone's wrath, devastating tribal settlements and homes. Despite the destruction, communal resilience is palpable as communities unite to rebuild. Lastly, in Chhattisgarh, tribal in Naxal stronghold Bastar voted in their village for the first time.
